full_track.tags: K-Pop and City Pop fusion. Clean electric guitar plays syncopated funk-style muted strums and arpeggiated chords. A slap bass guitar performs syncopated sixteenth-note patterns. Acoustic piano provides rhythmic stabs on the off-beats. The drum kit features a crisp snare and a steady kick with occasional open hi-hat accents. Male vocals are delivered in a smooth, melodic tenor range with light doubling in the chorus. Key of E Major. Tempo is 115 BPM. 4/4 time signature.
